text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! North Flight really has a 
commanding presence!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was wondering about the distance, 
but... it's totally doable!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I really thought Harp Alpha or Yukino 
Bijin were the big favorites for the Tiara 
route, but..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"She might just have a shot at the Shuka 
Sho...! Keep your eyes on North Flight 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight delivered a dazzling 
performance for the spectators. It seemed 
to bolster her confidence as well—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It has been decided. The best 
medium-distance coordination...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Bringing out the greatest brilliance 
within me, by making full use of my 
speed—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Combine the other materials cultivated so 
far to compensate for the distance 
extension.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho, I believe I will shine 
even brighter than I did today!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho will be the day she reveals 
her brilliance with the most thorough 
preparation of any race we've had so far."
choice_data_list: Let's shine with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final destination of a fun 
adventure... The ultimate goal, the Shuka 
Sho, is right before our eyes.
